cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. One sleepless night before your interview? I've been awake all week worrying about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need you to practise questions with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Ask why I left my last job. You'll understand why my interview is harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm scared I'll cry. Let's use your practice time to get me through the greeting.
